ARSENAL.TITLE: 🧰 MY ARSENAL
ARSENAL.EMPTY: Your arsenal is empty. Win a battle to steal your first weapon.

premise_flip.NAME: Premise Flip
premise_flip.DESC: You don't argue the claim — you challenge what it's standing on.
premise_flip.EXAMPLE: "Why does it even have to work that way?"

clarifying_question.NAME: Clarifying Question
clarifying_question.DESC: A precise question that stops vague talk in its tracks.

emotional_anchor.NAME: Emotional Anchor
emotional_anchor.DESC: You stay steady and name the emotion instead of getting swept up in it.
emotional_anchor.EXAMPLE: "I get why that's frustrating. Here's what the facts say."

fact_check.NAME: Fact Check
fact_check.DESC: You don't take a claim on faith — you check it out loud.
fact_check.EXAMPLE: "Where's that number from? Got a source?"

counterexample.NAME: Counterexample
counterexample.DESC: One sharp example that breaks their generalization.
counterexample.EXAMPLE: "What about the time it went the other way?"

steelman.NAME: Steelman
steelman.DESC: You state their position better than they did — then take that version down.
steelman.EXAMPLE: "If I'm getting this right, you mean... And yet..."

short_thesis.NAME: Short Thesis
short_thesis.DESC: One short, decisive line instead of three minutes of explaining.

reframe.NAME: Reframe
reframe.DESC: You change the terms the argument is judged by.
reframe.EXAMPLE: "It's not about who's right. It's about what actually works."
